cards.claim: Muon achieves substantially higher hard-rank scaling than AdamW on rare-token (TAIL) representations
cards.conditions: GPT-2 160M, FineWeb-Edu dataset, 3.15B tokens, batch size 1024, sequence length 512, Pre-RMSNorm, RoPE, squared-ReLU FFNs
cards.effect: Muon hard-rank scaling exponent β=1.02 vs AdamW β=0.44 on TAIL tokens (2.3× difference); mid-frequency (MID) tokens show AdamW-to-Muon gain of ~0.44 (Muon) vs 0.44 (AdamW)
cards.evidence: Empirical spectral rank measurement via Rényi entropy effective rank across FFN width sweeps
cards.quote: In the TAIL regime, AdamW reaches only β=0.44, whereas Muon and NorMuon achieve linear scaling with β=1.02 and β=1.04, respectively.

cards.claim: Matched validation loss does not imply matched spectral geometry or scaling behavior
cards.conditions: GPT-2 160M, AdamW trained 12K steps vs Dion(1/16) trained 6K steps, achieving equivalent perplexity
cards.effect: AdamW 12K achieves β_hard=0.03 (nearly zero hard-rank scaling) while Dion maintains β_hard=0.40-0.50 with matched loss; hard-soft asymmetry increases in AdamW from 0.37 to 0.41
cards.evidence: Direct comparison of spectral properties on models with equivalent validation loss
cards.quote: Although AdamW 12K matches Dion in perplexity (Table 13 in Appendix B.1), its aggregate hard-rank scaling nearly vanishes: β drops from 0.29 at 6K steps to 0.03 at 12K steps.

cards.claim: Update rank in orthogonalized optimizers constrains hard-capacity scaling independent of orthonormalization
cards.conditions: Dion variants at rank fractions 1/2 and 1/16, GPT-2 160M, same architecture and training protocol
cards.effect: Dion(1/2) achieves β_hard=0.88 in TAIL with asymmetry 0.07; Dion(1/16) drops to β_hard=0.40 with asymmetry 0.31—orthonormalization alone insufficient
cards.evidence: Spectral scaling law comparison isolating rank effects from orthonormalization effects
cards.quote: Thus, orthonormalization alone is insufficient: the rank of the optimizer update constrains how efficiently added FFN width becomes usable hard spectral capacity.
